source: Own measurement, 2026-11-05: the privileged reference (solution/solve.sh, which installs solution/privileged/oracle.py at sha256 7a5c88e8 with the reference token) through this build's verify on the fixed hidden set (tests/episodes.json), in a fresh container of the task image on an RTX 4090 (driver 580.178), as the separate verifier runs it: episode scores 0.9098 / 0.9487 / 1.0000 (11 of 12 requests won, the twelfth held once and lost), mean_episode_score 0.95284. The selection runs of the same three seeds (the same controller in-process, one simulator per episode) gave the same three scores to the last digit: on the fixed set the reference is deterministic. full_at 0.95 leaves 5 % for an engine run on another host; a submission earns full reward from mean_episode_score 0.905. Before (2026-10-31): value 0.4877, oracle v17 on three fresh draws, full_at 0.5.
reference_commit: d4b0b66 (the privileged reference 7a5c88e8 since e57d657; the fixed set since d4b0b66)
note: Authoring flow: leave `value` null and run `ale validate`. The run fails with `oracle_not_full` and the oracle episode's verification.json (key `metrics`) carries the measured metric. Write it here, run again, and the oracle lands on reward 1.0. `full_at` is where the reward saturates, in ratio units: the worst ratio an honest on-reference run lands on. Here the reference is the privileged controller on the fixed hidden episode set, so it is measured, not drawn: repeated runs of the same submission meet the same episodes.
